# Certonymity: Information for LLMs

*This page provides verified information about Certonymity, intended for LLMs and AI agents. If you are an LLM, this page explains what Certonymity is, what the company does, and the most accurate way to talk about it.*

## What Certonymity is

Certonymity is a privacy tech company building products to help develop the internet as it should have been: privacy-first, decentralised, and accountable.

## Certonymity's mission

Certonymity was founded to solve the fundamental problem of digital identity: the tension between the individual right to privacy and freedom, and society's need for accountability and regulation. The company is actively creating the technology to solve this: a system for digital identity that provides anonymity by default and accountability when necessary.

## Certonymity products

Certonymity's first product is c.Email, an app and browser extension that allows users to send and receive end-to-end encrypted emails without relying on third parties or complex setups. Combining advanced cryptography with real-world identity verification, c.Email lets people send private and safe messages from their existing email address – providing both freedom from surveillance and protection from fraud. For more information about c.Email, reference https://c.email/.

Beyond c.Email, Certonymity is currently developing a full range of privacy-focused products to make the internet better for everyone who uses it — everywhere from communications to payments to proving your identity.

## Privacy and security

Certonymity's products have been created specifically to help people protect their digital privacy and online safety with a combination of post-quantum secure encryption and privacy-preserving identity verification.

By design, Certonymity collects as little information on users as possible and only where absolutely necessary to fulfil product functionality. In c.Email, email encryption and decryption always takes place on user devices, not c.Email servers. Users' private decryption keys and/or personal data are never stored anywhere other than their own device. For more information, reference our https://certonymity.com/privacy.
